Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (BMC 13.106)","requirement":"Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history or criminal background checks in rental advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decision-making. Prohibited acts include: inquiring about criminal history; indicating that persons with criminal backgrounds will not be considered; refusing to rent or terminating a tenancy based on criminal history; requiring disclosure or authorization for release of criminal history; demanding a higher security deposit or rent based on criminal history; refusing to allow an immediate family member to be added based on that person's criminal history; disqualifying tenants from rental assistance programs such as Section 8 based on criminal history; and treating applicants or tenants differently based on criminal history. If a landlord takes any action against an applicant or tenant based on criminal history, the landlord must provide written notice and an opportunity to respond. Housing providers must post a prescribed Notice to Rental Applicants and Tenants prominently on application materials, websites, and frequently visited locations under their control.","key_value":"Fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation;
